question.text: A market index serves all the following purposes EXCEPT:

explanation.text: The Logic: Indices benchmark, measure, enable passive products. They do NOT guarantee returns. The Trap: Guaranteeing returns isn't an index function. Cross-Exam Context: XII, V-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Select index matched to mandate — NIFTY 50 vs NIFTY 500 vs Midcap has different risk/return profiles.
